description: This Java class provides utility functions for escaping strings to be used as valid MongoDB keys by replacing special characters.

classes.name: KeyEscapeUtil
classes.description: A utility class for escaping strings to be used as MongoDB keys, replacing special characters with escape sequences.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string so that it can be safely used as a MongoDB key by replacing special characters (~, $, .) with escape sequences.
